# DrinkFYI Embed Widget

> Embeddable DrinkFYI widgets for any website. Zero dependencies, Shadow DOM isolation, 4 themes (light/dark/sepia/auto).

## Quick Start

Add to any HTML page:
- Script: <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/drinkfyi-embed@1/dist/embed.min.js"></script>

## Links

- Main site: https://drinkfyi.com
- Widget docs: https://widget.drinkfyi.com
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/drinkfyi-embed
- GitHub: https://github.com/fyipedia/drinkfyi-embed
- API: https://drinkfyi.com/developers/
